verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents broad programmatic surfaces. The SQL API can perform queries and manage the deployment, including provisioning users and roles and creating tables. The REST APIs are pitched as enabling "end-to-end automation" of resources and ship OpenAPI specs and Postman collections. A CLI, drivers and a managed MCP server round this out, and Cortex Analyst and access history are exposed via REST or SQL views. However, nothing in the evidence asserts parity with the Snowsight UI, and several UI-centric features (notebooks, dashboards, the Query History page and query profile) have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, documented API coverage of Snowsight-only features (notebooks, dashboards, query profile), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
